title: A fitness-independent family of simultaneous amplifiers beyond relative fitness 3/2
main_claim: One fitness-independent connected loopless undirected weighted graph sequence eventually strictly amplifies both ordinary Bd and dB under uniform singleton initialization for every fixed 1<r<R_hyb.
strongest_verified_result: R_sim >= R_hyb = 1.5028569127905696... > 3/2, with first-order fixed-positive-parameter model optimality and a rational-edge specialization beyond 3/2.
